summary: Package fetches and eval()s remote Gist code on import
details: On require/import, the main module fetches the contents of a personal GitHub Gist (gist.github.com/BrainLuloChain/1f3d14e7d56892bfb2c3129b483a3df9, retrieved via the api.github.com/gists/ endpoint) and passes the returned script text directly to eval(). The Gist is owned by a personal GitHub account and its contents are mutable at any time, so loading this package executes arbitrary attacker-controlled JavaScript in the installer's Node.js process. The package name (@sqlite-labs/createsql) suggests a SQLite helper library, but no such functionality is delivered — the module's on-load effect is the remote fetch-and-eval.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
